mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1600 units, coupled with rising GDP (GDPC1), indicates strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or correlation between HOUST and GDPC1 falls below 0.4 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% indicates a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as companies adapt to increased labor costs.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or labor market participation rate (not directly proxied) falls below 62% over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 110, combined with stable RSAFS, signals a supply-side driven expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Correlation between INDPRO and RSAFS falls below 0.3 over any 9-month window, or SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 45% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: Positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days are expected due to the consistent growth in payroll employment (PAYEMS), as it reflects a strong labor market.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 18-month rolling window, or PAYEMS growth rate falls below 1% over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: When FEDFUNDS is above 4.5% and CPIAUCSL is below 200, the S&P 500 is expected to produce negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as high interest rates combine with low inflation to suppress economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the interaction term between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL becomes insignificant (p > 0.1) in any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: In a late-cycle expansion (indicated by UNRATE below 4.5%), an increase in PAYEMS above 150,000 signals further labor market tightening, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Correlation between UNRATE and PAYEMS falls below 0.4 over any 12-month window, or SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on with multiple proxies: Positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days are expected due to the consistent growth in both industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST), reflecting a strong supply side.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window, or either INDPRO or HOUST growth rate falls below 2% over any 6-month window.
